svg.text: 6061-T6 extrusion, 4 in OD × 1/8 in wall × 24 in stock. Ø95.25 nominal ID; verify Ø93.50 minimum clear bore.
Use uncut stock. Drill and deburr end-retention holes. 54.60 mm extra axial length is used for the patch-cable bay.
A–A and B–B on sheet 2; PCB mounting details on sheet 3. Remove front collar before sliding cassette out.
Four passive female 8P8C feedthroughs: CAEN only. Short internal leads terminate in top-entry PCB jacks.
